what: Large photo card. A background-color silhouette (a cut-out animal or person) sits at the bottom center of the photo as if rising out of it, and an arrow line is laid behind the title. On hover only the photo approaches from 1.2 → 1.3 scale in .8s ease, while the silhouette steps aside by 2%. The title’s background-color padding grows from 1em → 3em (.4s ease), hiding the start of the line. On release the photo returns in .4s. On devices without hover, the photo and silhouette stay as they are

options.--fx-shift: Distance the silhouette steps aside (ratio to panel width), default 2%
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photo slot (overflow hidden). Height is set by the user — the original is padding-top 110%
options.[data-fx-part=cutout]: (If present) Background-color silhouette SVG — size is up to the consumer (original 150×150)
options.[data-fx-part=head]·title·line: (If present) title row · title text in the background color · arrow row reaching the right edge

use: Title

from.where: Two-way card .np-duo on index.html and about.html (original #homeConNav — img scale(1.2) → :hover scale(1.3) .8s ease (.4s on return), .img-wrap::before white bear and dog 150px left 50% → 52% .8s, .title2 div padding-right 1em → 3em .4s, no photo zoom below 900px)
